country.evidence_quote: I still remember my first networking event after moving to Canada. It was organized by a professional engineering association, and I wasn't even aware of the “networking” concept yet. I stood in a corner, watching people talk and assuming they already knew each other; I didn’t want to interrupt their conversations. A colleague eventually introduced me to someone, and that simple introduction broke the ice. What I learned that evening was surprisingly simple:
